Green fell 8.0 percentage points of cost. Orange fell $76.9M (National HME exit, Affordable Care restructuring). The first-ever Red bucket appeared: $15.2M cost marked at $1.9M (12.5 cents) = Convey Health Solutions.
risk_rating_migration.cross_check_against_non_accrual: Only 1 of the 4 MD&A-narrated non-accruals is rated Red (Convey). AAC is Orange, Symplr is Yellow, and Transcendia - marked above cost while on non-accrual - is GREEN. Risk Rating and non-accrual status are therefore not co-monotone at NMFC.

part_one_income_incentive_fee.rate: 20.0% of Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income, calculated and payable QUARTERLY in arrears
part_one_income_incentive_fee.hurdle: 2.0% per quarter (8.0% annualized), measured as a rate of return on the value of net assets at the end of the IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING calendar quarter; pro-rated for partial periods
part_one_income_incentive_fee.catch_up: 100% of Pre-Incentive Fee NII between the 2.0% hurdle and 2.5% per quarter (10.0% annualized) goes to the Adviser; above 2.5%, 20%
part_one_income_incentive_fee.PIK_TREATMENT: PIK COUNTS TOWARD THE FEE. Verbatim: 'Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income includes, in the case of investments with a deferred interest feature (such as original issue discount, debt instruments with PIK interest and zero coupon securities), accrued income that the Company has not yet received in cash.' There is no cash-receipt condition and no clawback if the PIK is never collected.
part_one_income_incentive_fee.exclusions: Pre-Incentive Fee NII excludes realized capital gains/losses and unrealized appreciation/depreciation.
part_one_income_incentive_fee.total_return_or_NII_lookback: NONE. The filing discloses no total-return hurdle, no NII look-back and no cap tied to cumulative net returns on the Part 1 income fee. The ONLY loss linkage in the fee structure sits in Part 2 (capital gains fee), not Part 1.

part_two_capital_gains_incentive_fee.mechanic: Based only on ACTUAL realized capital gains computed net of all realized capital losses AND unrealized capital depreciation, on a CUMULATIVE basis from inception through the end of each calendar year.
part_two_capital_gains_incentive_fee.gaap_accrual: GAAP requires accrual of a HYPOTHETICAL capital gains incentive fee based on cumulative net realized gains/losses plus cumulative net unrealized appreciation/depreciation at each period end.
part_two_capital_gains_incentive_fee.reason: 'no actual capital gains incentive fee was owed... as cumulative net realized capital gains did not exceed cumulative unrealized capital depreciation' (Note 5 fn 1)
